task: Diagnose and resolve startup crash (exit code 15) and Tkinter running attribute error
changes: Identified root cause of exit code 15: _kill_other_instances() was matching its own parent .venv/Scripts/python.exe launcher shim and calling proc.terminate() (SIGTERM / code 15) on itself
Protected current process and all ancestor process PIDs (psutil.Process().parents()) in _kill_other_instances()
Fixed initialization order in LeagueLoopApp.__init__ so self.running is defined before _process_ui_queue() is called, preventing AttributeError: '_tkinter.tkapp' object has no attribute 'running'
Added phase_indicator property to QtPlayTab and aligned test_qt_ui.py window dimension assertions (980x660)
Verified clean startup and 296 passing tests in test suite
